caption: The drawing depicts a single straw bonnet, positioned on its side against a plain, light background. The bonnet is composed of tightly woven straw in shades of golden-brown and tan, forming a rounded crown and wide brim that curves outward. The inner lining of the brim is a soft, pale gray or whitish color with visible seams. Wrapped around the base of the crown is a wide, silk ribbon in muted tones of cream, beige, and pale yellow, which extends downward and lies unfurled in front of the bonnet, displaying creases and soft shadows. The ribbon's texture appears smooth and slightly reflective, contrasting with the matte, fibrous surface of the straw. There are no other objects or elements in the composition, and the focus is entirely on the bonnet and its detailed rendering.
title: Bonnet
